title: Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a five (5)-year sole source Contract with Performance Lighting Systems Inc.: Covering onsite support, training, and system maintenance of the nLight light
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a five (5)-year sole source Contract with Performance Lighting Systems Inc.: Covering onsite support, training, and system maintenance of the nLight lighting control system at Los Angeles International Airport, for cost not to exceed $149,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Five-year sole source contract with Performance Lighting Systems Inc. for maintenance and support of lighting control system at Los Angeles International Airport for $149,000.
